reference: The mirror is dusty. She says: I will clean it.
sk: Zrkadlo je zaprášené. Hovorí: Umyjem ho.
cz: Zrcadlo je zaprášené. Říká: Umyju ho.
acceptable: The mirror is {dusty|covered in dust|full of dust}. She says: I will {clean|wipe|wash} it.

mistakes.text: The mirror is dusty. She says: I am going to clean it.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri rýchlom rozhodnutí patrí „will“: „I will clean it“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U rychlého rozhodnutí patří „will“: „I will clean it“.

mistakes.text: The mirror is dusty. She says: I clean it.
The mirror is dusty. She say: I will clean it.
The mirror is dusty. She says: I will cleaning it.
The mirror is dusty. She says: I will clean {him|her}.
